title: potentilla halacsyana subsp. regis-borisii
intro: Potentilla halacsyana subsp. regis-borisii, commonly known as the Hungarian cinquefoil, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of P. halacsyana subsp. regis-borisii include treating wounds, infections, and various inflammatory conditions, largely attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The exact bioactive constituents of P. halacsyana subsp. regis-borisii are not well-documented, but it is known to have a high concentration of flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
